pages.title: Kekule Ring
pages.text: A ring of six carbons whose electrons belong to the whole ring at once: aromatic, and far more stable than its bonds alone would make it. Dropped by the Ouroboros. Held as a catalyst in the Polymeriser (it never wears), it makes Aramid Fibre from Organic Evaporite.
$(thing)Dropped by$(): The Ouroboros.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Alkahest Still.
